method.label: Formula
method.value: (0.6 × evidence quality + 0.4 × field coverage) × source-gate factor − finding penalties

method.label: Evidence quality
method.value: Sum of each lineage count × its weight, divided by the total claim count, × 100. No claims gives evidence quality 0.

method.label: Lineage weights
method.value: Directly Sourced 1.0; Calculated 0.9; Assumption-Based 0.5; Analyst Inference 0.4; Weak Lineage 0.3; Untraced 0.0; Conflicting 0.0; Insufficient Information 0.0

method.label: Finding penalties
method.value: CRITICAL 40; MATERIAL 15; MINOR 3 points per finding

method.label: Caps and rounding
method.value: Clamp to 0–100. Any CRITICAL finding caps the score at 39 (Blocked); otherwise any MATERIAL finding caps it at 59 (Restricted). Otherwise Passed. Round to the nearest integer, half to even.
